name: עַכְסָה
summary: Joshua and Judges name Achsah as Caleb’s daughter and Othniel’s wife. She asks her father for springs to go with the land he has given her. Chronicles also lists a daughter of Caleb named Achsah.

evidence.note: Caleb gives Achsah to Othniel after the capture of Kiriath-sepher.
Achsah asks for springs and receives the upper and lower springs.
The genealogy ends this section by naming Achsah as Caleb’s daughter.

note: The name shares the consonants of עֶכֶס ‘anklet’ and adds a feminine ending. The naming passages give no interpretation. The two TIPNR records preserve the narrative and genealogical references.
